answer: The bug was in `StripTrailingSemicolonFilter::process` where it used an `or` instead of an `and` in the while loop condition, causing an `IndexError` when `stmt.tokens` was empty because it tried to access `stmt.tokens[-1]`. I changed the condition from `while stmt.tokens or (stmt.tokens[-1].is_whitespace ...)` to `while stmt.tokens and (stmt.tokens[-1].is_whitespace ...)`.

The bug was in `StripTrailingSemicolonFilter.process` where the condition `while stmt.tokens or (stmt.tokens[-1].is_whitespace or stmt.tokens[-1].value == ';')` caused an `IndexError` when `stmt.tokens` became empty because it evaluated the second part of the `or` even if `stmt.tokens` was empty. I changed it to `while stmt.tokens and (stmt.tokens[-1].is_whitespace or stmt.tokens[-1].value == ';')`.
